    parent: ResolvingMetadata
  ) => Promise<any> | any
  generateViewport?: (

    parent: ResolvingViewport
  ) => Promise<any> | any
  metadata?: any
  viewport?: any
}

type LayoutConfig<Route extends LayoutRoutes = LayoutRoutes> = {

  ) => Promise<any> | any

    parent: ResolvingViewport
  ) => Promise<any> | any
  metadata?: any
  viewport?: any
}
